posts.title: e-means Makes k-means Worth Another Look
posts.description: e-means reaches standard k-means quality in far fewer passes. What changes, what stays the same, and why cheaper clustering is worth another look.

posts.title: Lowercase Is a Mood, Now a Chrome Extension
posts.description: A Chrome extension with one a/A switch that renders the site you are on in lowercase. Display-only, saved per site, no network requests.

posts.title: When AI Lies About Your Search Data
posts.description: How FUSE's Emet pipeline checks AI answers about search data: declared receipts, a deterministic verifier whose tolerance comes from how a number was written, and a judge from a different model provider, with the research behind each choice.
